name: Task Verdict
description: Turn any delegated task's claims into checkable evidence: write a manifest of evidence-bound checks, run it, get PASS / FAIL / PARTIAL — computed from evidence, never from the subagent's prose.
caption: Task Verdict — Orchestration receipts for delegated work. Write the checks before delegating, run them after. 7 check types: URL status/content, file exists/sha256/regex, JSON fields, pattern counts — with timeouts and base-dir sandboxing.
honest_limits: PASS proves the listed checks passed at run time — not that the task was good. Unverifiable is reported as PARTIAL, never rounded up to a pass.
